officialApp.name: realme Link
officialApp.appVersionObserved: 5.8.811.2814 (APK mirror listing, 2026-11-10); the review screenshot predates this and its version was not shown
officialApp.notes: realme Link is the official companion app; some features also appear in realme phone Bluetooth settings.

battery.chargingIndicators: Case LED; numeric L/R levels in realme Link.
battery.notes: DIRECT EVIDENCE: the realme Link device page for Buds T300 shows two separate readings, L 100% and R 100%, and no case tile at all. This matches the user's report of split L/R on a T300. The official 40 h figure is buds + case with ANC off; the app does not surface the case percentage. Contrast with CMF Buds 1, whose Nothing X page shows L/C/R including a case tile.

anc.notes: 30 dB ANC with transparency; no adaptive levels.

audio.notes: 12.4 mm dynamic bass driver; 6-band EQ at 62/250/1k/4k/8k/16k Hz in the realme Link screenshot.
